title: newshell_llm: an LLM-first ooRexx shell with plans, recovery and a security manager
purpose: Continuity for newshell_llm v0.1-dev6 and the decisions of 24 Nov 2026 (plans on RTO2, the Auth, naming, witnesses): shell objects for an LLM, proposals checked against method source, the security manager and policy, plans and watches that report back, died-step recovery chains, Codex as a principal on an MU (nsh-agent, job store), network, service, audit and xtpd objects, the cats1 policy and kit. Architecture: Tom Dyer. Coding and writing: Claude (Opus 5.5), 24 November 2026; Computer.cls v0.1 and the first ShellObject by ChatGPT.
